fast high order methods for interface tracking can be constructed by tracking wavelet vectors instead of markers.

high order interface tracking methods can be made faster by using wavelet vectors instead of marker points, that they can be constructed using explicit Runge– Kutta methods and that the order of accuracy can be preserved by using a suitable high order wavelet subdivision scheme.
